name: Global Algebraic Sum Bounding
description: Replaced the local LCM condition with a global sum over all edges. The local function $f(c_u, c_v) = 3 c_u + 3 c_v - 2 c_u c_v$ evaluates to 5 if $c_u \neq c_v$ and 4 if $c_u = c_v$. By requiring the global sum over $m$ edges to be exactly $5m$, the problem forces every edge to evaluate to 5 (since 5 is the maximum possible value). This requires the model to independently deduce the upper bound of the local function and realize that the global sum condition is mathematically equivalent to strict local 2-coloring, preventing simple pattern-matching on the edge condition.
